English:
Alice Margatroid is an all-around witch, capable of offense, healing, support, debuffing, and protection.

Alice possesses five unique 'dolls.' By commanding these dolls, she can unleash various abilities and gain different stat bonuses. In battle, Alice must gather dolls in her hand and then issue orders—whether to act, strengthen, or convert resources. However, opportunities to command dolls are limited, so every move must be carefully calculated.

Through meticulous planning, take control of the battlefield with her proud dolls and become the core of the fight!
Chinese:
爱丽丝·玛格特罗伊德是全才全能的魔女，不论是进攻、治疗、辅助、削弱或是保护都能胜任。

爱丽丝拥有5种独特的“人偶”，通过役使这些人偶，爱丽丝能施展各种不同的能力，也能获得不同的属性加成。在战斗中，爱丽丝需要积攒手中的人偶，然后对人偶们下达指令——是执行行动、还是蓄势强化、亦或是转换资源。不过，对人偶们下达指令的机会有限，所以每一步都需要精打细算。

在精密的计算之下，使用引以为豪的人偶们控制战场、成为战斗的核心吧！
发现弱点了！
从死角发起攻击！
在盘算下一步怎么做吗？
